execution: two GPUs per project, projects sequential
future_backbone: RETFound requires a separate adapter and checkpoint audit
actual_gpu_memory: query allocated GPU; do not assume A100 has 80 GiB
memory_policy: Do not fill memory for its own sake; account for project CUDA, NCCL and nonproject use, retain additional transient headroom
effective_batch: select a common target after representative memory and throughput preflight; do not silently increase historical batch or LR
microbatch_policy: may differ with explicit accumulation; ordinary BN is not equivalent across microbatches
original_data: independent ongoing full raw transfer; use existing cache only for infrastructure preflight
initial_backbone_status: planned; requires R&B 2D/3D bottleneck adapter and fresh parent/basis validation
cohort: expanded original paired UKB after complete-copy and label/split audit
disease_targets: review public UKB phenotype definitions before choosing disease-specific binary tasks or shared multi-label heads
hyperparameters: retune on development only under a prespecified shared search budget; old test is not a tuning set
bridge_width: recalculate stage channels and use explicit r/h; do not blindly carry old rho to a larger backbone
